      "observations": [
        "Read all 95 owned diff lines and the entire original 120-line class. The new keydown listener handles only ArrowUp/ArrowDown, directly queries the previous/next DOM element sibling for input, optionally calls focus and always calls preventDefault in either branch. It does not traverse logical adapter indices, materialize off-screen rows, filter hidden/uncheckable inputs or duplicate Tab/twisty order. No successful native focus or scrolling result is inferred.",
        "The owned fillRow removes row-level level/set-size/position and expanded writes plus the cell's ariaLabel. Under accessibilityEnabled or automation, it writes row index, level, set size and position to the twisty and checkbox. It leaves expanded state on the twisty, reads the visible name from viewRow.texts.name and hides uncheckable checkboxes. These are exact affected receiver assignments, not a universal ARIA policy.",
        "The original class already sets twistyButton.ariaLabel = viewRow.texts.name at line 99; this is not a later-only addition. Its template places the twisty outside the sibling label, while that label contains the visible span and checkbox input. The button therefore has an explicit label source and the checkbox has an actual wrapping label in both original and fixed source. Native accessible-name computation was not executed.",
        "Fixed code retains the keyboard path and label sources. It later adds a bubbling checkbox change handler and subtree/ancestor checked-state aggregation; the original instead uses a direct checkbox.onchange assignment. Those later state-propagation changes are outside this landing's owned behavior and are not fully re-audited here.",
        "No tests or assertions change in this commit. The bounded later fixture instantiates this exact row class, and the current selected keyboard test uses Space to check tri-state data/checkbox changes. That is not direct evidence for adjacent-row arrows, hidden inputs, virtualized boundary navigation or screen-reader names. All assertions in the selected test window have nonempty state messages; missing should alone is not treated as a defect.",
        "Manual review checks the actual customized tr and concrete button/input/span receivers. Optional chaining is deliberate for a missing sibling/input. Comments describe previous/next-row action but do not promise hidden-row skipping. A scoped readability suggestion is to separate the container/span/checkbox declarations from the accessibility guard. The earlier shared lesson 8e9fe2… stays provisional; narrow checked facts are added separately without promoting its broader assistive-technology interpretation.",
        "Read complete retained primary 2021790 current comments 0–6/activity/footer from exact original dfbcd2b4… with original B collector/time preserved. It abandons an earlier role=checkbox proposal, describes selection ownership as a separate patch and later reports the keyboard/ARIA landing. Related 2003150/D288582 bodies remain locators, not substitute source or extra audits.",
